## 2.1 przypisywanie do kategorii

```{r}
meta <- tibble(sample = sample_names) %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      grepl("HomSap", sample) ~ "Human",
      grepl("PanTro", sample) ~ "Chimpanzee",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    condition_chemical = case_when(
      grepl("AG94", sample) ~ "AG94",
      grepl("AG93", sample) ~ "AG93",
      grepl("Mandy0?6", sample) ~ "Mandy6",
      grepl("Mandy0?4", sample) ~ "Mandy4",
      grepl("ELE30", sample) ~ "ELE30",
      grepl("GM36", sample) ~ "GM36",
      grepl("Kimby12", sample) ~ "Kimby12",
      grepl("Kimby16", sample) ~ "Kimby16",
      grepl("SandraA", sample) ~ "SandraA",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    condition_date = case_when(
      grepl("RNA_Seq_05\\.24", sample) ~ "05.24",
      grepl("RNA_Seq_12\\.24", sample) ~ "12.24",
      grepl("RNA_Seq_03\\.25", sample) ~ "03.25",
      grepl("RNA_Seq_05\\.25", sample) ~ "05.25",
      grepl("RNA_Seq_01\\.26", sample) ~ "01.26",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    condition_prep = case_when(
      grepl("IFprep", sample) ~ "IFprep",
      grepl("OPprep", sample) ~ "OPprep",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    ),
    condition_timepoint = case_when(
      grepl("P0\\.RatHPC", sample) ~ "P0",
      grepl("14D_cocultures", sample) ~ "14D",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    condition_rep = case_when(
      grepl("Rep4", sample) ~ "Rep4",
      grepl("Rep5", sample) ~ "Rep5",
      grepl("Rep6", sample) ~ "Rep6",
      grepl("Rep7", sample) ~ "Rep7",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species),
    condition_chemical = factor(condition_chemical),
    condition_date = factor(condition_date),
    condition_prep = factor(condition_prep),
    condition_timepoint = factor(condition_timepoint),
    condition_rep = factor(condition_rep)
  )

meta <- as.data.frame(meta)
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample
meta$sample <- NULL

table(meta$species, useNA = "ifany")
table(meta$condition_chemical, useNA = "ifany")
table(meta$condition_date, useNA = "ifany")
table(meta$condition_prep, useNA = "ifany")
```

# 5.0 Run DESeq2

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

meta_sub_no_outliers$species <- droplevels(meta_sub_no_outliers$species)
meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_date <- droplevels(meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_date)

meta_sub_no_outliers$species <- relevel(meta_sub_no_outliers$species, ref = "Chimpanzee")
nrow(count_mat_sub_no_outliers)
human_vs_chimp <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(count_mat_sub_no_outliers),
  colData   = meta_sub_no_outliers,
  design    = ~ condition_date + species
)

human_vs_chimp <- DESeq(human_vs_chimp, fitType = 'local')

res <- results(human_vs_chimp)

# keep only genes used for testing
res_filtered <- res[!is.na(res$padj), ]


# logical vector of genes to keep
keep_genes <- !is.na(res$padj)

# subset DESeqDataSet properly
human_vs_chimp <- human_vs_chimp[keep_genes, ]

human_vs_chimp_counts <- counts(human_vs_chimp, normalized = TRUE)
human_vs_chimp_vsn <- vst(human_vs_chimp, blind = FALSE)
human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts <- assay(human_vs_chimp_vsn)

# write.csv(human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts, "~/Desktop/expression.csv")

res_human_vs_chimp <- results(
  human_vs_chimp,
  contrast = c("species", "Human", "Chimpanzee")
)

nrow(human_vs_chimp)


#Prepare Data for GO enrichment(Separate from previous step with wgcna)
down_genes <- rownames(res_human_vs_chimp)[
  !is.na(res_human_vs_chimp$padj) &
  res_human_vs_chimp$log2FoldChange < -0.59 &
  res_human_vs_chimp$padj < 0.1
]

up_genes <- rownames(res_human_vs_chimp)[
  !is.na(res_human_vs_chimp$padj) &
  res_human_vs_chimp$log2FoldChange > 0.59 &
  res_human_vs_chimp$padj < 0.1
]



# keep only genes present in filtered VST matrix
down_genes_filt <- intersect(down_genes, colnames(human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts))
up_genes_filt   <- intersect(up_genes, colnames(human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts))

# subset normalized matrix
norm.down <- human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts[, down_genes_filt, drop = FALSE]
norm.up   <- human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts[, up_genes_filt, drop = FALSE]



length(down_genes)
length(up_genes)
```

## Loading Autoencoder results

```{r}
latent <- read.csv("~/Desktop/latent_space.csv", row.names = 1)

dim(latent)
head(latent)

str(latent)
summary(latent)
```

```{r}
#ТУТ МОЖНО ПОСМОТРЕТЬ ТОП СКОРРЕЛИРОВАННЫХ ГЕНОВ С КАИМ_ТО ГЕНОМ НАС ИНТЕРЕСУЮЩИМ, НО НИЖНИЙ ЧАНК БЕЗ НЕГО НЕ РАБОТЕТ

get_top_neighbors_latent <- function(target_gene,
                                     latent,
                                     n = 50,
                                     min_similarity = NULL) {

  if (!(target_gene %in% rownames(latent))) {
    warning(paste(target_gene, "not found in latent"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  candidate_genes <- rownames(latent)
  candidate_genes <- candidate_genes[
    candidate_genes != target_gene
  ]

  target_vec <- as.numeric(
    latent[target_gene, ]
  )

  cosine_vec <- apply(
    latent[candidate_genes, , drop = FALSE],
    1,
    function(x) {
      x <- as.numeric(x)
      sum(target_vec * x) /
        (sqrt(sum(target_vec^2)) * sqrt(sum(x^2)))
    }
  )

  cosine_vec <- cosine_vec[!is.na(cosine_vec)]

  if (!is.null(min_similarity)) {
    cosine_vec <- cosine_vec[
      cosine_vec >= min_similarity
    ]
  }

  top_neighbors <- sort(
    cosine_vec,
    decreasing = TRUE
  )[1:min(n, length(cosine_vec))]

  data.frame(
    target_gene = target_gene,
    neighbor_gene = names(top_neighbors),
    latent_similarity = as.numeric(top_neighbors)
  )
}
```

## Top neighboors latent symbol

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Top 500 DESeq genes
top500_deseq_genes <- as.data.frame(res_filtered) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    padj,
    dplyr::desc(abs(log2FoldChange))
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 500) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene)

# 2. Keep only genes present in latent space
top500_deseq_genes <- top500_deseq_genes[
  top500_deseq_genes %in% rownames(latent)
]

# 3. For each top DESeq gene, find top 20 latent-space neighbors
latent_neighbors_top500_deseq <- lapply(
  top500_deseq_genes,
  function(g) {
    get_top_neighbors_latent(
      target_gene = g,
      latent = latent,
      n = 20,
      min_similarity = 0.85
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# View(latent_neighbors_top500_deseq)
```

## ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbols

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(dplyr)

network_table <- latent_neighbors_top500

network_table <- network_table |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("neighbor_symbol"))

neighbor_map <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  unique(network_table$neighbor_gene),
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = "SYMBOL",
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

network_table <- network_table |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    neighbor_map,
    by = c("neighbor_gene" = "ENSEMBL")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    neighbor_symbol = SYMBOL
  )

head(network_table)
colnames(network_table)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(igraph)
library(plotly)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)

# 1. Network table from top-variable latent neighbors
network_table <- latent_neighbors_top500

# 2. All graph genes
all_graph_genes <- unique(c(
  network_table$target_gene,
  network_table$neighbor_gene
))

all_graph_genes_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", all_graph_genes)

# 3. Map ENSRNOG -> ENTREZ + SYMBOL
gene_map <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  all_graph_genes_clean,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 4. GO enrichment for all graph genes
go_graph <- enrichGO(
  gene = unique(gene_map$ENTREZID),
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  readable = FALSE
)

go_graph_df <- as.data.frame(go_graph)

# 5. Assign one top GO process to each gene
gene_GO_annotation <- go_graph_df |>
  dplyr::select(
    GO_process = Description,
    GO_padj = p.adjust,
    geneID
  ) |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") |>
  dplyr::rename(ENTREZID = geneID) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_map, by = "ENTREZID") |>
  dplyr::arrange(GO_padj) |>
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    gene = ENSEMBL,
    gene_symbol = SYMBOL
  )

#6. Edges
edges <- network_table |>
  dplyr::select(
    from = target_gene,
    to = neighbor_gene,
    weight = latent_similarity
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

# 7. Nodes
nodes <- data.frame(
  gene = unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_GO_annotation |>
      dplyr::select(gene, GO_process, gene_symbol),
    by = "gene"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GO_process = ifelse(is.na(GO_process), "No_GO_enrichment", GO_process),
    gene_symbol = ifelse(is.na(gene_symbol), gene, gene_symbol)
  )

print(table(nodes$GO_process))

# 8. Group genes spatially by GO process
set.seed(123)

go_groups <- unique(nodes$GO_process)

go_centers <- data.frame(
  GO_process = go_groups,
  center_x = rnorm(length(go_groups), mean = 0, sd = 8),
  center_y = rnorm(length(go_groups), mean = 0, sd = 8),
  center_z = rnorm(length(go_groups), mean = 0, sd = 8)
)

nodes_plot <- nodes |>
  dplyr::left_join(go_centers, by = "GO_process") |>
  dplyr::group_by(GO_process) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    x = center_x + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 1.2),
    y = center_y + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 1.2),
    z = center_z + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 1.2)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# 9. Edge coordinates
edge_coords <- edges |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_plot,
    by = c("from" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    x_from = x,
    y_from = y,
    z_from = z,
    GO_from = GO_process
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_plot,
    by = c("to" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    x_to = x,
    y_to = y,
    z_to = z,
    GO_to = GO_process
  )

# GO cluster-to-cluster connections

#посмотреть доступные GO кластеры
# sort(unique(c(cluster_links$cluster_A, cluster_links$cluster_B)))

# GO cluster-to-cluster connections
cluster_links <- edge_coords |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(GO_from), !is.na(GO_to)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster_A = pmin(GO_from, GO_to),
    cluster_B = pmax(GO_from, GO_to),
    cluster_pair = paste(cluster_A, cluster_B, sep = " <-> ")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_A, cluster_B, cluster_pair) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges = dplyr::n(),
    mean_similarity = mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_similarity = max(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_edges),
    dplyr::desc(mean_similarity)
  )

# View(cluster_links)
```

## Так выглядит корелляция генов многих GO enrichments сразу со многими другими GO

```{r}
#ПОКА ЧТО ВЫКЛЮЧУ ПОТОМУ ЧТО R НЕ ПАШЕТ, ВЫРУБАЕТ СЕССИЮ ИЗ-ЗА НЕ ХВАТКИ ПАМЯТИ
library(dplyr)
library(visNetwork)

# Use GO-clustered nodes from previous working 3D layout
vis_nodes <- nodes_plot |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    id = gene,
    label = gene,
    group = GO_process,
    title = paste0(
      "Gene: ", gene,
      "<br>GO process: ", GO_process
    ),
    x = x * 100,
    y = y * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(id, label, group, title, x, y)

# Use existing edges
vis_edges <- edges |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    title = paste0("Similarity: ", round(weight, 3)),
    color = "black",
    width = 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(from, to, title, color, width)

visNetwork(vis_nodes, vis_edges, height = "850px", width = "100%") |>
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = TRUE,
    selectedBy = "group"
  ) |>
  visEdges(
    color = list(color = "black"),
    smooth = FALSE
  ) |>
  visPhysics(
    enabled = FALSE
  ) |>
  visInteraction(
    navigationButtons = TRUE,
    zoomView = TRUE,
    dragNodes = TRUE
  )


```

## Посмотреть с какими GO в наибольшей степеени коррелирует тот или иной GO по количеству нитей

```{r}
#ВОЗМОЖНО ЭТОТ ЧАНК НУЖЕН ДЛЯ ЗАПУСКА НИЗ-ИДУЩЕГО, ЕСЛИ НЕТ _ УДАЛИ

latent_mat <- as.matrix(latent)

# normalize rows for cosine similarity
latent_norm <- latent_mat / sqrt(rowSums(latent_mat^2))

# cosine similarity matrix
sim_mat <- latent_norm %*% t(latent_norm)

diag(sim_mat) <- NA

top_n <- 5
min_similarity <- 0.9

edges_all <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(sim_mat)),
  function(i) {
    sims <- sim_mat[i, ]
    sims <- sims[!is.na(sims)]
    sims <- sims[sims >= min_similarity]
    
    if (length(sims) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    top_sims <- sort(sims, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(top_n, length(sims))]
    
    data.frame(
      from = rownames(sim_mat)[i],
      to = names(top_sims),
      weight = as.numeric(top_sims)
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(visNetwork)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)

# ============================================================
# Selected GO-centered latent neighbor network
# ============================================================

selected_GO <- "actin filament organization"

top_selected_genes <- 100
top_neighbors_per_gene <- 100
min_similarity <- 0.85
drop_no_go <- TRUE

# 1. Take genes belonging to selected GO process
selected_GO_genes <- nodes_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(GO_process == selected_GO) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene) |>
  unique()

selected_GO_genes <- intersect(selected_GO_genes, rownames(latent))
selected_GO_genes <- head(selected_GO_genes, top_selected_genes)

# 2. Get top latent-space neighbors for each selected GO gene
selected_GO_neighbors <- lapply(
  selected_GO_genes,
  function(g) {
    get_top_neighbors_latent(
      target_gene = g,
      latent = latent,
      n = top_neighbors_per_gene,
      min_similarity = min_similarity
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# 3. Build edges
edges_selected_GO <- selected_GO_neighbors |>
  dplyr::select(
    from = target_gene,
    to = neighbor_gene,
    weight = latent_similarity
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

# 4. Genes included in graph
graph_genes <- unique(c(
  edges_selected_GO$from,
  edges_selected_GO$to
))

graph_genes_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", graph_genes)

# 5. Map genes to Entrez/Symbol
gene_map <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  graph_genes_clean,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 6. GO enrichment for graph genes
go_graph <- enrichGO(
  gene = unique(gene_map$ENTREZID),
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  readable = FALSE
)

go_graph_df <- as.data.frame(go_graph)

# 7. Assign one strongest GO process to each gene
gene_GO_annotation <- go_graph_df |>
  dplyr::select(
    GO_process = Description,
    GO_padj = p.adjust,
    geneID
  ) |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") |>
  dplyr::rename(ENTREZID = geneID) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_map, by = "ENTREZID") |>
  dplyr::arrange(GO_padj) |>
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    gene = ENSEMBL,
    gene_symbol = SYMBOL
  )

# 8. Create nodes
nodes_selected_GO <- data.frame(gene = graph_genes) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_GO_annotation |>
      dplyr::select(gene, GO_process, gene_symbol),
    by = "gene"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GO_process = ifelse(is.na(GO_process), "No_GO_enrichment", GO_process),
    gene_symbol = ifelse(is.na(gene_symbol), gene, gene_symbol),
    node_type = ifelse(gene %in% selected_GO_genes, "selected_GO_gene", "neighbor_gene"),
    GO_process = ifelse(node_type == "selected_GO_gene", selected_GO, GO_process)
  )

# 9. Optionally remove No_GO_enrichment neighbor genes
if (drop_no_go) {
  keep_genes <- nodes_selected_GO |>
    dplyr::filter(GO_process != "No_GO_enrichment" | node_type == "selected_GO_gene") |>
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  nodes_selected_GO <- nodes_selected_GO |>
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% keep_genes)

  edges_selected_GO <- edges_selected_GO |>
    dplyr::filter(from %in% keep_genes, to %in% keep_genes)
}

# 10. Keep only connected nodes
connected_genes <- unique(c(edges_selected_GO$from, edges_selected_GO$to))

nodes_selected_GO <- nodes_selected_GO |>
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% connected_genes)

# 11. Spatial layout:
# selected GO in center, other GO processes around it
set.seed(123)

other_GO <- setdiff(unique(nodes_selected_GO$GO_process), selected_GO)

angle <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = length(other_GO) + 1)[-1]
radius <- 900

go_centers <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    GO_process = selected_GO,
    center_x = 0,
    center_y = 0
  ),
  data.frame(
    GO_process = other_GO,
    center_x = radius * cos(angle),
    center_y = radius * sin(angle)
  )
)

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_selected_GO |>
  dplyr::left_join(go_centers, by = "GO_process") |>
  dplyr::group_by(GO_process) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    x = center_x + rnorm(
      dplyr::n(),
      0,
      ifelse(GO_process == selected_GO, 170, 90)
    ),
    y = center_y + rnorm(
      dplyr::n(),
      0,
      ifelse(GO_process == selected_GO, 170, 90)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# 12. visNetwork nodes
vis_nodes <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    id = gene,
    label = gene_symbol,
    group = GO_process,
    value = ifelse(node_type == "selected_GO_gene", 22, 12),
    title = paste0(
      "Gene ID: ", gene,
      "<br>Symbol: ", gene_symbol,
      "<br>GO process: ", GO_process,
      "<br>Node type: ", node_type
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(id, label, group, value, title, x, y)

# 13. visNetwork edges
vis_edges <- edges_selected_GO |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    title = paste0("Latent similarity: ", round(weight, 3)),
    color = "black",
    width = 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(from, to, title, color, width)
```

# В ПОИСКАХ HUB GENES FROM WGCNA

# 9.0 Estimating sft

```{r}
#przepisuje tu obiekt-pochodna od Deseq2 - human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts, zeby dopasowac go format do dozwolonego w WGCNA(czyli robie t() )
human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts <- t(assay(human_vs_chimp_vsn))

# making powers vector
library(WGCNA)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
allowWGCNAThreads()

gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts, verbose = 3)

if (!gsg$allOK) {
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts <- human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes]
} else {
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts <- human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts
}


power <- c(1:20, seq(22, 50, 2))
length(power)

sft <- pickSoftThreshold(
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts,
  powerVector = power,
  networkType = "signed",
  verbose = 5
)

sft.data <- sft$fitIndices

cat("Requested powers:", length(power), "\n")
cat("Returned rows:", nrow(sft.data), "\n")

```

```{r}
#usuniecie batch efektu przed przeprowadzeniem wgcna

library(limma)

# align samples in expression matrix to metadata
gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_sub <- gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts[
  rownames(meta_sub_no_outliers), , drop = FALSE
]

# check that sample order is now identical
stopifnot(identical(rownames(gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_sub),
                    rownames(meta_sub_no_outliers)))

# drop unused factor levels
meta_sub_no_outliers$species <- droplevels(meta_sub_no_outliers$species)
meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_date <- droplevels(meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_date)

# limma expects genes x samples, so transpose
gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_sub_t <- t(gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_sub)

# preserve biological signal of interest
design_species <- model.matrix(~ species, data = meta_sub_no_outliers)

# remove technical batch effect before WGCNA
gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_corrected_t <- removeBatchEffect(
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_sub_t,
  batch = meta_sub_no_outliers$condition_date,
  design = design_species
)

# transpose back: samples x genes for WGCNA
gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_corrected <- t(gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_corrected_t)

# final check
dim(gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts_corrected)

```

```{r}
#ТУТ ВОЗМОЖНО СЛЕДУЕТ ОПРОБОВАТЬ РАЗНЫЕ СОФТ ПАВЕР ПОПРОБОВАТЬ И СМОТРЕТЬ ПО СМЫСЛУ ЧТО БОЛЬШЕ ПОДХОДИТ. ПОТОМУ ЧТО 29 ВРОДЕ КАК НЕ ТИПИЧНО БОЛЬШОЕ ЗНАЧЕНИЕ SOFT POWER

#| results: false

# make matrix numeric
gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts[] <- sapply(gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts, as.numeric)
#29 - 20 модулей получил
soft_power <- 29
temp_cor <- cor
cor <- WGCNA::cor

soft_power <- 29

blockwisenet <- blockwiseModules(
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts,
  maxBlockSize = 15000,
  TOMType = "signed",
  networkType = "signed",
  power = soft_power,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
  numericLabels = FALSE,
  randomSeed = 1234,
  verbose = 3,
  corFnc = "cor",
  corOptions = list(method = "spearman")
)

```

## 11.2 moduls presence and eigengene escimating

```{r}
#| results: false

#Module Eigengene Infromation

head(module_eigengenes)

dim(module_eigengenes)
colnames(module_eigengenes)
```

## 11.3 moduls significance

```{r}
#| results: false

library(limma)

# grey modul zazwyczaj usuwaja
module_eigengenes_sub <- module_eigengenes[, colnames(module_eigengenes) != "MEgrey", drop = FALSE]


# spawdzenie kolejnosci
module_eigengenes_sub <- module_eigengenes_sub[rownames(meta_sub_no_outliers), , drop = FALSE]

# design matrix: batch + species
design <- model.matrix(~ condition_date + species, data = meta_sub_no_outliers)

# matrix of modules: modules x samples
ME_mat <- t(module_eigengenes_sub)

# checks
stopifnot(nrow(design) == ncol(ME_mat))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(design), colnames(ME_mat)))

# limma model
fit <- lmFit(ME_mat, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# coefficient for Human vs Chimpanzee
coef_name <- grep("^species", colnames(design), value = TRUE)[1]
coef_name

# results table
me_stats <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")

# add module names
me_stats$module <- rownames(me_stats)

# keep key columns
me_stats <- me_stats[, c("module", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")]

# view top modules
head(me_stats, 20)
```

```{r}
#ЗНАЧЕМЫЕ МОДУЛИ
sig_modules <- me_stats$module[me_stats$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
sig_modules
```

```{r}
#Get module colors for each gene
module_colors <- blockwisenet$colors
names(module_colors) <- colnames(gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts)
```

```{r}
#Calculate module membership / kME
MEs <- moduleEigengenes(
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts,
  colors = module_colors
)$eigengenes

MEs <- orderMEs(MEs)

kME <- signedKME(
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts,
  MEs,
  corFnc = "cor",
  corOptions = 'use = "p", method = "spearman"'
)
```

```{r}
#Extract hub genes from one module
module_name <- "MEblue"
color <- sub("^ME", "", module_name)

genes_in_module <- names(module_colors)[module_colors == color]

kME_col <- paste0("kME", color)

hub_genes_blue <- data.frame(
  gene = genes_in_module,
  kME = kME[genes_in_module, kME_col]
)

hub_genes_blue <- hub_genes_blue[order(abs(hub_genes_blue$kME), decreasing = TRUE), ]

head(hub_genes_blue, 20)
```

```{r}
#Extract hub genes from all significant WGCNA modules

hub_list <- lapply(sig_modules, function(module_name) {
  
  color <- sub("^ME", "", module_name)
  genes_in_module <- names(module_colors)[module_colors == color]
  kME_col <- paste0("kME", color)
  
  hubs <- data.frame(
    module = module_name,
    gene = genes_in_module,
    kME = kME[genes_in_module, kME_col]
  )
  
  hubs <- hubs[order(abs(hubs$kME), decreasing = TRUE), ]
  
  hubs
})

hub_genes <- do.call(rbind, hub_list)
# View(hub_genes)
```

```{r}
#condition-relevant hubs
trait <- meta_sub_no_outliers$species
trait_numeric <- as.numeric(trait == "Human")

GS <- cor(
  gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts,
  trait_numeric,
  method = "spearman"
)

GS <- as.data.frame(GS)
colnames(GS) <- "GS_species"

hub_genes$GS_species <- GS[hub_genes$gene, "GS_species"]

hub_genes <- hub_genes[
  order(abs(hub_genes$kME), abs(hub_genes$GS_species), decreasing = TRUE),
]

head(hub_genes, 50)
```

```{r}
# Save significant hub genes for each significant module

  ]

    paste0(
      gsub("^ME", "", mod),
      "_significant_hub_genes.txt"
    )
  )
  
  write.table(
    genes,
    file = file_name,
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
  string_edges,
  combined_score >= 0.7 &
  (
    X.node1 %in% overlap_hubs |
    node2 %in% overlap_hubs
  )
)
View(hub_interactions)

#Extract all interacting proteins
all_neighbors <- unique(c(
  hub_interactions$X.node1,
  hub_interactions$node2
))
all_neighbors



#Посмотреть внешние интерактивные гены моих hub-генов, но внимание, ими могут оказаться сами же hub-гены! и тогда получится 0, но смысл от этого не теряется 

#Remove the hub genes themselves:
neighbor_proteins <- setdiff(
  all_neighbors,
  overlap_hubs
)

#shows all proteins connected to at least one of my hub genes
length(neighbor_proteins)
head(neighbor_proteins, 20)

```

# WGCNA hub-centered network

```{r,fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
#ТУТ РАЗНЫМИ ЦВЕТАМИ ГЕНЫ ИЗ ТОГО ИЛИ ИНОГО КЛАСТЕРА WGCNA, В ЧАНКЕ НИЖЕ ТАМ ЦВЕТА УЖЕ СОГЛАСНО ПРИНАДЛЕЖНОСТИ К ОПРЕДЕЛЕННОМУ GO

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(WGCNA)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)

# ============================================================
# WGCNA hub-centered network
# Core nodes = WGCNA hub genes
# Secondary nodes = genes strongly correlated with hubs in WGCNA data
# STRING-supported genes = black
# ============================================================

top_hubs_to_plot <- 30
top_neighbors_per_hub <- 13
min_wgcna_cor <- 0.6

datExpr <- gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts

# Gene-module annotation
gene_module_colors <- blockwisenet$colors
names(gene_module_colors) <- colnames(datExpr)

module_annotation <- data.frame(
  gene = colnames(datExpr),
  module = gene_module_colors
)

# Add gene symbols
gene_map <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  module_annotation$gene,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = "SYMBOL",
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db
)

module_annotation <- module_annotation |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_map,
    by = c("gene" = "ENSEMBL")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    gene_symbol = SYMBOL
  )

# Select hub genes
# Recreate hub_core cleanly
hub_core <- hub_genes |>
  dplyr::filter(
    symbol %in% overlap_hubs
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    symbol,
    module,
    kME,
    GS_species
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    gene_symbol = symbol
  )

# colnames(hub_core)
# head(hub_core)
hub_gene_ids <- hub_core$gene

# Function: WGCNA-correlated neighbors for one hub
get_wgcna_neighbors <- function(target_gene, datExpr, n = 50, min_cor = 0.6) {
  
  if (!(target_gene %in% colnames(datExpr))) {
    warning(paste(target_gene, "not found in datExpr"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cor_vec <- WGCNA::cor(
    datExpr[, target_gene],
    datExpr,
    use = "p",
    method = "spearman"
  )
  
  cor_vec <- as.numeric(cor_vec)
  names(cor_vec) <- colnames(datExpr)
  
  cor_vec <- cor_vec[!is.na(cor_vec)]
  cor_vec <- cor_vec[names(cor_vec) != target_gene]
  cor_vec <- cor_vec[cor_vec >= min_cor]
  
  top_neighbors <- sort(cor_vec, decreasing = TRUE)[
    1:min(n, length(cor_vec))
  ]
  
  data.frame(
    hub_gene = target_gene,
    neighbor_gene = names(top_neighbors),
    wgcna_correlation = as.numeric(top_neighbors)
  )
}

# Get neighbors for all hubs
wgcna_hub_neighbors <- lapply(
  hub_gene_ids,
  function(g) {
    get_wgcna_neighbors(
      target_gene = g,
      datExpr = datExpr,
      n = top_neighbors_per_hub,
      min_cor = min_wgcna_cor
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# Add symbols and modules
wgcna_hub_neighbors <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_annotation |>
      dplyr::select(
        hub_gene = gene,
        hub_symbol = gene_symbol,
        hub_module = module
      ),
    by = "hub_gene"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_annotation |>
      dplyr::select(
        neighbor_gene = gene,
        neighbor_symbol = gene_symbol,
        neighbor_module = module
      ),
    by = "neighbor_gene"
  )

# STRING proteins
string_proteins <- unique(c(
  string_edges$X.node1,
  string_edges$node2
))

# Edges
edges_plot <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::select(
    from = hub_gene,
    to = neighbor_gene,
    weight = wgcna_correlation
  )

# Nodes
nodes_hub <- hub_core |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    gene_symbol,
    module,
    node_type = "hub"
  )

nodes_neighbor <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = neighbor_gene,
    gene_symbol = neighbor_symbol,
    module = neighbor_module,
    node_type = "neighbor"
  )

nodes_for_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  nodes_hub,
  nodes_neighbor
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_STRING = gene_symbol %in% string_proteins,
    label_to_show = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene_symbol,
      gene
    )
  )

# Hub-centered layout
set.seed(123)

n_hubs <- nrow(nodes_hub)

hub_positions <- nodes_hub |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_hubs + 1)[-1],
    x = 400 * cos(angle),
    y = 400 * sin(angle)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, x, y)

neighbor_positions <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    hub_positions |>
      dplyr::select(hub_gene = gene, hub_x = x, hub_y = y),
    by = "hub_gene"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(hub_gene) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    local_angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = dplyr::n() + 1)[-1],
    local_radius = runif(dplyr::n(), 700, 1300),
    x = hub_x + local_radius * cos(local_angle),
    y = hub_y + local_radius * sin(local_angle)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(gene = neighbor_gene, x, y)

node_positions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  hub_positions,
  neighbor_positions
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_positions, by = "gene")

# Edge coordinates
edges_plot <- edges_plot |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("from" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(x_from = x, y_from = y) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("to" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(x_to = x, y_to = y) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(x_from),
    !is.na(y_from),
    !is.na(x_to),
    !is.na(y_to)
  )

# Colors and sizes
module_levels <- unique(nodes_for_plot$module)

module_palette <- colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
)(length(module_levels))

names(module_palette) <- module_levels

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    node_fill = dplyr::case_when(
      is_STRING ~ "black",
      node_type == "hub" ~ "red",
      TRUE ~ module_palette[module]
    ),
    node_size = dplyr::case_when(
      node_type == "hub" ~ 6,
      is_STRING ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ 3
    )
  )

# Plot
p_wgcna_string <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_from,
      y = y_from,
      xend = x_to,
      yend = y_to,
      alpha = weight
    ),
    color = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = nodes_for_plot,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    fill = nodes_for_plot$node_fill,
    size = nodes_for_plot$node_size,
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = nodes_for_plot,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = label_to_show
    ),
    size = 2.7,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "WGCNA hub-centered network",
    subtitle = "Red = WGCNA hub genes; colored = WGCNA-correlated neighbors; black = STRING-supported genes"
  )

p_wgcna_string
```

## Отсортированный WGCNA hub-centered network

```{r,fig.height=16, fig.width=16}

#ВОТ ТУТ ПОЛУЧИЛОСЬ ЧТО НУЖНО
#отсортированный(согласно GO), WGCNA hub-centered network
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(WGCNA)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)

# ============================================================
# WGCNA hub-centered network with GO grouping
# Core nodes = WGCNA hub genes
# Neighbor nodes = WGCNA-correlated genes
# Color = GO biological process
# Red border = hub gene
# Black border = STRING-supported gene
# ============================================================

top_neighbors_per_hub <- 13
min_wgcna_cor <- 0.6

datExpr <- gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts

# ----------------------------
# 1. Gene-module annotation
# ----------------------------

gene_module_colors <- blockwisenet$colors
names(gene_module_colors) <- colnames(datExpr)

module_annotation <- data.frame(
  gene = colnames(datExpr),
  module = gene_module_colors
)

gene_map <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  module_annotation$gene,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = "SYMBOL",
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db
)

module_annotation <- module_annotation |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_map, by = c("gene" = "ENSEMBL")) |>
  dplyr::rename(gene_symbol = SYMBOL)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Hub genes
# ----------------------------

hub_core <- hub_genes |>
  dplyr::filter(symbol %in% overlap_hubs) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, symbol, module, kME, GS_species) |>
  dplyr::rename(gene_symbol = symbol)

hub_gene_ids <- hub_core$gene

# ----------------------------
# 3. Function: WGCNA neighbors
# ----------------------------

get_wgcna_neighbors <- function(target_gene, datExpr, n = 50, min_cor = 0.6) {
  
  if (!(target_gene %in% colnames(datExpr))) {
    warning(paste(target_gene, "not found in datExpr"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cor_vec <- WGCNA::cor(
    datExpr[, target_gene],
    datExpr,
    use = "p",
    method = "spearman"
  )
  
  cor_vec <- as.numeric(cor_vec)
  names(cor_vec) <- colnames(datExpr)
  
  cor_vec <- cor_vec[!is.na(cor_vec)]
  cor_vec <- cor_vec[names(cor_vec) != target_gene]
  cor_vec <- cor_vec[cor_vec >= min_cor]
  
  top_neighbors <- sort(cor_vec, decreasing = TRUE)[
    1:min(n, length(cor_vec))
  ]
  
  data.frame(
    hub_gene = target_gene,
    neighbor_gene = names(top_neighbors),
    wgcna_correlation = as.numeric(top_neighbors)
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 4. Get WGCNA neighbors
# ----------------------------

wgcna_hub_neighbors <- lapply(
  hub_gene_ids,
  function(g) {
    get_wgcna_neighbors(
      target_gene = g,
      datExpr = datExpr,
      n = top_neighbors_per_hub,
      min_cor = min_wgcna_cor
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

wgcna_hub_neighbors <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_annotation |>
      dplyr::select(
        hub_gene = gene,
        hub_symbol = gene_symbol,
        hub_module = module
      ),
    by = "hub_gene"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_annotation |>
      dplyr::select(
        neighbor_gene = gene,
        neighbor_symbol = gene_symbol,
        neighbor_module = module
      ),
    by = "neighbor_gene"
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5. GO enrichment for hub genes
# ----------------------------

hub_GO <- enrichGO(
  gene = hub_gene_ids,
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENSEMBL",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  readable = FALSE
)

hub_GO_simplified <- clusterProfiler::simplify(
  hub_GO,
  cutoff = 0.7,
  by = "p.adjust",
  select_fun = min
)

hub_GO_df <- as.data.frame(hub_GO_simplified)

hub_gene_GO_annotation <- hub_GO_df |>
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") |>
  dplyr::rename(gene = geneID) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    GO_process = Description,
    GO_padj = p.adjust,
    main_GO_process = Description
  )

# ----------------------------
# 6. GO enrichment for neighbor genes
# ----------------------------

neighbor_gene_ids <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::pull(neighbor_gene) |>
  unique()

neighbor_GO <- enrichGO(
  gene = neighbor_gene_ids,
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENSEMBL",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  readable = FALSE
)

neighbor_GO_simplified <- clusterProfiler::simplify(
  neighbor_GO,
  cutoff = 0.7,
  by = "p.adjust",
  select_fun = min
)

neighbor_GO_df <- as.data.frame(neighbor_GO_simplified)

neighbor_gene_GO_annotation <- neighbor_GO_df |>
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") |>
  dplyr::rename(gene = geneID) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    GO_process = Description,
    GO_padj = p.adjust,
    main_GO_process = Description
  )

# ----------------------------
# 7. STRING-supported proteins
# ----------------------------

string_proteins <- unique(c(
  string_edges$X.node1,
  string_edges$node2
))

# ----------------------------
# 8. Edges
# ----------------------------

edges_plot <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::select(
    from = hub_gene,
    to = neighbor_gene,
    weight = wgcna_correlation
  )

# ----------------------------
# 9. Nodes with GO annotation
# ----------------------------

nodes_hub <- hub_core |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    gene_symbol,
    module,
    node_type = "hub"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    hub_gene_GO_annotation,
    by = "gene"
  )

nodes_neighbor <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = neighbor_gene,
    gene_symbol = neighbor_symbol,
    module = neighbor_module,
    node_type = "neighbor"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    neighbor_gene_GO_annotation,
    by = "gene"
  )

nodes_for_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  nodes_hub,
  nodes_neighbor
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GO_process = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(GO_process),
      "No_GO_annotation",
      GO_process
    ),
    main_GO_process = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(main_GO_process),
      "No_GO_annotation",
      main_GO_process
    ),
    is_STRING = gene_symbol %in% string_proteins,
    label_to_show = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene_symbol,
      gene
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 10. Layout: hubs center, neighbors grouped by GO
# ----------------------------

set.seed(123)

n_hubs <- nrow(nodes_hub)

hub_positions <- nodes_hub |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_hubs + 1)[-1],
    x = 400 * cos(angle),
    y = 400 * sin(angle)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, x, y)

go_centers <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "neighbor") |>
  dplyr::distinct(main_GO_process) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    go_angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = dplyr::n() + 1)[-1],
    go_x = 1800 * cos(go_angle),
    go_y = 1800 * sin(go_angle)
  )

neighbor_positions <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "neighbor") |>
  dplyr::left_join(go_centers, by = "main_GO_process") |>
  dplyr::group_by(main_GO_process) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    local_angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = dplyr::n() + 1)[-1],
    local_radius = runif(dplyr::n(), 100, 500),
    x = go_x + local_radius * cos(local_angle),
    y = go_y + local_radius * sin(local_angle)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(gene, x, y)

node_positions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  hub_positions,
  neighbor_positions
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("x", "y"))) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    node_positions,
    by = "gene"
  )

stopifnot(all(c("x", "y") %in% colnames(nodes_for_plot)))

# ----------------------------
# 11. Edge coordinates
# ----------------------------

edges_plot <- edges_plot |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("from" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    x_from = x,
    y_from = y
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("to" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    x_to = x,
    y_to = y
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(x_from),
    !is.na(y_from),
    !is.na(x_to),
    !is.na(y_to)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 12. Colors and sizes
# ----------------------------

GO_levels <- unique(nodes_for_plot$main_GO_process)

GO_palette <- colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
)(length(GO_levels))

names(GO_palette) <- GO_levels

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    node_fill = GO_palette[main_GO_process],
    node_border = dplyr::case_when(
      node_type == "hub" ~ "red",
      is_STRING ~ "black",
      TRUE ~ "white"
    ),
    node_size = dplyr::case_when(
      node_type == "hub" ~ 7,
      is_STRING ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ 3
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 13. GO cluster labels
# ----------------------------

cluster_labels <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(main_GO_process) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    label_x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    label_y = max(y, na.rm = TRUE) + 180,
    n_genes = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14. Plot
# ----------------------------

p_wgcna_go <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_from,
      y = y_from,
      xend = x_to,
      yend = y_to,
      alpha = weight
    ),
    color = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = nodes_for_plot,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    fill = nodes_for_plot$node_fill,
    color = nodes_for_plot$node_border,
    size = nodes_for_plot$node_size,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cluster_labels,
    aes(
      x = label_x,
      y = label_y,
      label = paste0(
        main_GO_process,
        "\n",
        n_genes,
        " genes"
      )
    ),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = nodes_for_plot,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = label_to_show
    ),
    size = 2.7,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5,
      color = "grey30"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "WGCNA hub-centered network grouped by GO enrichment",
    subtitle = "Fill color = GO process; red border = WGCNA hub; black border = STRING-supported gene"
  )

p_wgcna_go
```

## Genes that received No_GO_annotation in the network

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Genes that received No_GO_annotation in the network
# Retrieve all Biological Process GO annotations for them
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(GO.db)

# ----------------------------
# 1. Extract genes that were labelled No_GO_annotation
# ----------------------------

no_go_genes_tbl <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(main_GO_process == "No_GO_annotation") |>
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    gene_symbol,
    module,
    node_type,
    is_STRING
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

# ----------------------------
# 2. Retrieve GO annotations from org.Rn.eg.db
# ----------------------------

no_go_direct_GO <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Rn.eg.db,
  keys = no_go_genes_tbl$gene,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c(
    "ENSEMBL",
    "SYMBOL",
    "GO",
    "ONTOLOGY",
    "EVIDENCE"
  )
) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    ONTOLOGY == "BP",
    !is.na(GO)
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    gene = ENSEMBL,
    gene_symbol_db = SYMBOL,
    GO_ID = GO,
    GO_ontology = ONTOLOGY,
    GO_evidence = EVIDENCE
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3. Add GO term names
# ----------------------------

no_go_direct_GO <- no_go_direct_GO |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GO_term = AnnotationDbi::Term(
      GO.db::GOTERM[GO_ID]
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4. Collapse GO terms per gene
# ----------------------------

no_go_GO_summary <- no_go_direct_GO |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    gene,
    gene_symbol_db
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_BP_GO_terms = dplyr::n_distinct(GO_ID),
    BP_GO_terms = paste(
      unique(GO_term),
      collapse = " | "
    ),
    BP_GO_IDs = paste(
      unique(GO_ID),
      collapse = " | "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    no_go_genes_tbl,
    by = "gene"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_BP_GO_terms)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5. Inspect results
# ----------------------------

View(no_go_GO_summary)

head(no_go_GO_summary)

nrow(no_go_GO_summary)
```

# Autoencoder-WGCNA hub-centered network

```{r,fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(GO.db)

set.seed(123)

# ============================================================
# WGCNA hub-centered network with GO fallback annotation
# ============================================================

# 1. Clean nodes
nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::select(
    -dplyr::any_of(c(
      "GO_process", "x", "y",
      "x.x", "y.x", "x.y", "y.y",
      "node_fill", "node_size"
    ))
  )

# 2. Get full GO BP annotations for all plotted genes
all_symbols <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::pull(gene_symbol) |>
  unique() |>
  na.omit()

GO_full <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Rn.eg.db,
  keys = all_symbols,
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL", "GO", "ONTOLOGY")
) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(GO),
    ONTOLOGY == "BP"
  )

GO_terms <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(GO_full$GO),
  keytype = "GOID",
  columns = "TERM"
)

GO_full_named <- GO_full |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    GO_terms,
    by = c("GO" = "GOID")
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TERM))

# 3. Choose one GO Biological Process per gene
gene_GO_fallback <- GO_full_named |>
  dplyr::group_by(SYMBOL) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    GO_process = dplyr::first(TERM),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4. Add GO annotation to nodes
nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_GO_fallback,
    by = c("gene_symbol" = "SYMBOL")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GO_process = dplyr::case_when(
      node_type == "hub" ~ "Hub genes",
      !is.na(GO_process) ~ GO_process,
      TRUE ~ "No GO annotation"
    )
  )

# 5. Hub positions: compact central cloud
hub_positions <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "hub") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    x = rnorm(dplyr::n(), mean = 0, sd = 220),
    y = rnorm(dplyr::n(), mean = 0, sd = 220)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, x, y)

# 6. GO centers for neighbors
GO_levels <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "neighbor") |>
  dplyr::pull(GO_process) |>
  unique()

GO_centers <- data.frame(
  GO_process = GO_levels,
  center_x = 2600 * cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = length(GO_levels) + 1)[-1]),
  center_y = 2600 * sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = length(GO_levels) + 1)[-1])
)

# 7. Neighbor positions around GO centers
neighbor_positions <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "neighbor") |>
  dplyr::left_join(GO_centers, by = "GO_process") |>
  dplyr::group_by(GO_process) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    local_angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = dplyr::n() + 1)[-1],
    local_radius = runif(dplyr::n(), 120, 650),
    x = center_x + local_radius * cos(local_angle),
    y = center_y + local_radius * sin(local_angle)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(gene, x, y)

# 8. Attach coordinates
node_positions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  hub_positions,
  neighbor_positions
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_positions, by = "gene")

# Safety check
sum(is.na(nodes_for_plot$x) | is.na(nodes_for_plot$y))

# 9. Edges
edges_base <- wgcna_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::select(
    from = hub_gene,
    to = neighbor_gene,
    weight = wgcna_correlation
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

edges_plot <- edges_base |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("from" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(x_from = x, y_from = y) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("to" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(x_to = x, y_to = y) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(x_from),
    !is.na(y_from),
    !is.na(x_to),
    !is.na(y_to)
  )

# 10. Colors
GO_color_levels <- unique(nodes_for_plot$GO_process)

GO_palette <- colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
)(length(GO_color_levels))

names(GO_palette) <- GO_color_levels
GO_palette["Hub genes"] <- "red"
GO_palette["No GO annotation"] <- "grey75"

# 11. Cluster labels
cluster_labels <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::group_by(GO_process) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    label_x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    label_y = max(y, na.rm = TRUE) + 180,
    n_genes = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 12. Plot
p_wgcna_string <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_from,
      y = y_from,
      xend = x_to,
      yend = y_to,
      alpha = weight
    ),
    color = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = nodes_for_plot,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      fill = GO_process,
      size = node_type
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::filter(is_STRING),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    fill = "black",
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    size = 4.5,
    stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = nodes_for_plot,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = label_to_show
    ),
    size = 2.7,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cluster_labels,
    aes(
      x = label_x,
      y = label_y,
      label = paste0(GO_process, "\n", n_genes, " genes")
    ),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = GO_palette,
    name = "GO process"
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c(
      hub = 6,
      neighbor = 3
    ),
    name = "Node type"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "WGCNA hub-centered network",
    subtitle = "Center = WGCNA hub genes; outer clusters = WGCNA-correlated genes grouped by GO Biological Process; black = present in STRING"
  )

p_wgcna_string
```

```{r}
# Latent-space hub-neighbor network grouped by GO Biological Process

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(GO.db)
library(png)
library(grid)

set.seed(123)

top_neighbors_per_hub <- 15
min_similarity <- 0.7

# 1. Hub genes
hub_gene_ids <- hub_core$gene

# 2. Latent-space cosine similarity neighbors
get_top_neighbors_latent <- function(target_gene,
                                     latent,
                                     n = 15,
                                     min_similarity = NULL) {
  
  if (!(target_gene %in% rownames(latent))) {
    warning(paste(target_gene, "not found in latent"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  candidate_genes <- rownames(latent)
  candidate_genes <- candidate_genes[candidate_genes != target_gene]
  
  target_vec <- as.numeric(latent[target_gene, ])
  
  cosine_vec <- apply(
    latent[candidate_genes, , drop = FALSE],
    1,
    function(x) {
      x <- as.numeric(x)
      sum(target_vec * x) /
        (sqrt(sum(target_vec^2)) * sqrt(sum(x^2)))
    }
  )
  
  cosine_vec <- cosine_vec[!is.na(cosine_vec)]
  
  if (!is.null(min_similarity)) {
    cosine_vec <- cosine_vec[cosine_vec >= min_similarity]
  }
  
  top_neighbors <- sort(cosine_vec, decreasing = TRUE)[
    1:min(n, length(cosine_vec))
  ]
  
  data.frame(
    hub_gene = target_gene,
    neighbor_gene = names(top_neighbors),
    latent_similarity = as.numeric(top_neighbors)
  )
}

# 3. Get latent neighbors
latent_hub_neighbors <- lapply(
  hub_gene_ids,
  function(g) {
    get_top_neighbors_latent(
      target_gene = g,
      latent = latent,
      n = top_neighbors_per_hub,
      min_similarity = min_similarity
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# 4. Add gene symbols
all_plot_genes <- unique(c(
  latent_hub_neighbors$hub_gene,
  latent_hub_neighbors$neighbor_gene
))

gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Rn.eg.db,
  keys = all_plot_genes,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = "SYMBOL"
) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

latent_hub_neighbors <- latent_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_map |> dplyr::rename(hub_symbol = SYMBOL),
    by = c("hub_gene" = "ENSEMBL")
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_map |> dplyr::rename(neighbor_symbol = SYMBOL),
    by = c("neighbor_gene" = "ENSEMBL")
  )

# 5. Nodes
nodes_hub <- latent_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::select(
    gene = hub_gene,
    gene_symbol = hub_symbol
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::mutate(node_type = "hub")

nodes_neighbor <- latent_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::select(
    gene = neighbor_gene,
    gene_symbol = neighbor_symbol
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::mutate(node_type = "neighbor")

nodes_for_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(nodes_hub, nodes_neighbor) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_to_show = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol, gene)
  )

# 6. GO annotation
all_symbols <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::pull(gene_symbol) |>
  unique() |>
  na.omit()


GO_full <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Rn.eg.db,
  keys = all_symbols,
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL", "GO", "ONTOLOGY")
) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(GO), ONTOLOGY == "BP")

GO_terms <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(GO_full$GO),
  keytype = "GOID",
  columns = "TERM"
)

GO_full_named <- GO_full |>
  dplyr::left_join(GO_terms, by = c("GO" = "GOID")) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TERM))

gene_GO_fallback <- GO_full_named |>
  dplyr::group_by(SYMBOL) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    GO_process = dplyr::first(TERM),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_GO_fallback,
    by = c("gene_symbol" = "SYMBOL")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GO_process = dplyr::case_when(
      node_type == "hub" ~ "Hub genes",
      !is.na(GO_process) ~ GO_process,
      TRUE ~ "No GO annotation"
    )
  )

# 7. Layout: compact readable version
cluster_radius <- 1200
local_min <- 80
local_max <- 250

hub_positions <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "hub") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    x = rnorm(dplyr::n(), mean = 0, sd = 120),
    y = rnorm(dplyr::n(), mean = 0, sd = 120)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, x, y)

GO_levels <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "neighbor") |>
  dplyr::pull(GO_process) |>
  unique()

GO_centers <- data.frame(
  GO_process = GO_levels,
  center_x = cluster_radius * cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = length(GO_levels) + 1)[-1]),
  center_y = cluster_radius * sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = length(GO_levels) + 1)[-1])
)

neighbor_positions <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(node_type == "neighbor") |>
  dplyr::left_join(GO_centers, by = "GO_process") |>
  dplyr::group_by(GO_process) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    local_angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = dplyr::n() + 1)[-1],
    local_radius = runif(dplyr::n(), local_min, local_max),
    x = center_x + local_radius * cos(local_angle),
    y = center_y + local_radius * sin(local_angle)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(gene, x, y)

node_positions <- dplyr::bind_rows(hub_positions, neighbor_positions) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes_for_plot <- nodes_for_plot |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_positions, by = "gene")

# 8. Edges
edges_plot <- latent_hub_neighbors |>
  dplyr::select(
    from = hub_gene,
    to = neighbor_gene,
    weight = latent_similarity
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("from" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(x_from = x, y_from = y) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::select(gene, x, y),
    by = c("to" = "gene")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(x_to = x, y_to = y) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(x_from),
    !is.na(y_from),
    !is.na(x_to),
    !is.na(y_to)
  )

# 9. Colors
GO_color_levels <- unique(nodes_for_plot$GO_process)

GO_palette <- colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
)(length(GO_color_levels))

names(GO_palette) <- GO_color_levels
GO_palette["Hub genes"] <- "red"
GO_palette["No GO annotation"] <- "grey75"

# 10. Plot
p_latent_hub_network_readable <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_from,
      y = y_from,
      xend = x_to,
      yend = y_to,
      alpha = weight
    ),
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = nodes_for_plot,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      fill = GO_process,
      size = node_type
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = nodes_for_plot |> dplyr::filter(node_type == "hub"),
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = label_to_show
    ),
    size = 4,
    vjust = -1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = GO_palette,
    name = "GO Biological Process"
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c(hub = 10, neighbor = 5),
    name = "Node type"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.2, 0.85)) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# 11. Save and open inside R
out_file <- "/home/aleks/Desktop/latent_hub_network_readable.png"


ggsave(
  filename = out_file,
  plot = p_latent_hub_network_readable,
  width = 36,
  height = 28,
  dpi = 400,
  limitsize = FALSE
)

img <- png::readPNG(out_file)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.raster(img)
```

## Watch wich neighboors of my hub-genes are DEG

```{r}
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)

deg_table <- as.data.frame(res_human_vs_chimp)

# Save Ensembl IDs from rownames
deg_table$gene_id <- rownames(deg_table)

# Remove possible Ensembl version suffix, if present
deg_table$gene_id_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", deg_table$gene_id)

# Map rat Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
deg_table$symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Rn.eg.db,
  keys = deg_table$gene_id_clean,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

head(deg_table[, c("gene_id", "gene_id_clean", "symbol")], 20)


neighbor_deg <- deg_table[
  deg_table$symbol %in% neighbor_df$protein,
]

neighbor_deg$n_hub_connections <- neighbor_df$n_hub_connections[
  match(neighbor_deg$symbol, neighbor_df$protein)
]

# Keep only statistically significant DEGs
neighbor_deg <- subset(
  neighbor_deg,
  !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.1
)

# Sort by significance
neighbor_deg <- neighbor_deg[
  order(neighbor_deg$padj),
]

neighbor_deg[, c(
  "symbol",
  "log2FoldChange",
  "pvalue",
  "padj",
  "n_hub_connections"
)]
```

## ХОЧУ НАЙТИ BRIDGE GENES

```{r}

library(WGCNA)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

datExpr <- gsg_human_vs_chimp_vsn_counts

moduleColors <- blockwisenet$colors
names(moduleColors) <- colnames(datExpr)

MEs <- blockwisenet$MEs

# Checks
dim(datExpr)
length(moduleColors)
length(moduleColors) == ncol(datExpr)
head(moduleColors)
head(MEs)

# Create gene-module membership table
geneModuleMembership <- as.data.frame(
  WGCNA::cor(
    datExpr,
    MEs,
    use = "p",
    method = "spearman"
  )
)

# Important: rows are genes, so assign gene names
rownames(geneModuleMembership) <- colnames(datExpr)

# Add gene column
geneModuleMembership <- geneModuleMembership |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")

# Find WGCNA bridge genes:
# genes strongly associated with at least 2 module eigengenes
bridge_genes_wgcna <- geneModuleMembership |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_strong_modules = sum(abs(dplyr::c_across(starts_with("ME"))) >= 0.6),
    strongest_module = names(which.max(abs(dplyr::c_across(starts_with("ME"))))),
    strongest_kME = max(abs(dplyr::c_across(starts_with("ME"))))
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(n_strong_modules >= 2) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_strong_modules),
    dplyr::desc(strongest_kME)
  )
```

## STRING network genes that are differentially expressed

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)

# 1. Read STRING file
string_tbl <- read.delim(
  "/home/aleks/Desktop/GO:Enrichment project/STRING_BRIDGE_GENES/neighboors for the bridge-genes/string_interactions_short.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

# 2. DESeq results: Ensembl IDs are in rownames
res_human_vs_chimp_df <- as.data.frame(res_human_vs_chimp) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene")

# 3. Clean Ensembl IDs if needed
res_human_vs_chimp_df <- res_human_vs_chimp_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ensembl_gene_clean = gsub("\\..*", "", ensembl_gene)
  )

# 4. Map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
gene_map <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  res_human_vs_chimp_df$ensembl_gene_clean,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = "SYMBOL",
  OrgDb = org.Rn.eg.db
)

# 5. Add SYMBOL to DESeq results
res_human_vs_chimp_symbol <- res_human_vs_chimp_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_map,
    by = c("ensembl_gene_clean" = "ENSEMBL")
  )

# 6. Extract unique STRING genes from both interaction columns
string_genes <- string_tbl |>
  dplyr::select(X.node1, node2) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    values_to = "SYMBOL"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

# 7. Join STRING genes with DESeq results by SYMBOL
string_genes_deg <- string_genes |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    res_human_vs_chimp_symbol,
    by = "SYMBOL"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_DEG = !is.na(padj) &
      padj < 0.05 &
      abs(log2FoldChange) > 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(is_DEG),
    padj,
    dplyr::desc(abs(log2FoldChange))
  )

# View(string_genes_deg)

# Optional: only significant DEG genes from STRING
string_genes_DEG_only <- string_genes_deg |>
  dplyr::filter(is_DEG)

View(string_genes_DEG_only)
```
